name: personas
description: A home for reusable agent personas — craft & analysis experts (algorithmist, analyst, librarian, negotiator, recruiter, rubyist, rustacean, scribe) and a moderator-chaired decision council (PM, hacker, staff engineer, production engineer, platform expert, skeptic) you can summon in any project. Each is a self-contained system prompt; most work in two modes — critique or do.
